descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Rollercoaster Build It puts a whole theme park in your hands.

BUILD
Open the round build store and buy track piece by piece: straights, turns, wide turns, S-curves, hills, climbing turns and a full loop. Point at the end of your track and the next piece snaps into place. Flip a piece to turn the other way or take a hill back down. Supports appear under raised track automatically.

RIDE
Put coaster cars on your track, step into one and go. The train follows every rail you laid, crawling over the hilltops and racing through the dips and loops. Close the circuit and it keeps looping until you get off. Prefer a gentler ride? Switch on level horizon in the menu.

RUN YOUR PARK
Lay paths and queue lines, build a station, and set up food stalls, drink stands, toilets, benches, trees and flowers. Guests walk in through the gate, wander your paths, buy snacks and cheer as your coaster goes by. Every ticket and snack adds to your budget.

- 40 things to build: track, scenery, paths and rides
- Ride what you build, loops included
- A 120 by 120 metre park to fill
- Your park, cars and money save automatically
- Music all the way through

Early Access: more rides, track styles and park items are on the way.
